subject: Request: Full pen test report access + NDA carve-outs
messages:
From: Maya Lanning <security@fincorp.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Harold Bishop <procurement@fincorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: pen test report + exec summary access for procurement review

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement and security want to review Redwood's latest penetration test (Oct 2026) as part of our contract review. We need:

- The executive summary (suitable for our legal and risk teams).
- Full technical report access for our security reviewers (SC clearance).

FinCo's procurement/legal will not sign an NDA that broadly allows download and local copies — we prefer a read-only, time-limited viewer or a redacted package with clear carve-outs. Can you confirm what delivery options you support and any standard redaction policy?

Also include any remediation tracker that maps findings to fixes and ETA.

Thanks,
Maya Lanning
Head of Security Operations
FinCo Financial
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Lanning <security@fincorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary access for procurement review

Hi Maya — appreciate the clear ask. Short answer: we can do both (a fully redacted downloadable exec summary + gated, timebound viewer for the full report). A few important notes:

- Redwood standard: exec summary is cleared for sharing with customer orgs once basic redaction is applied (no vendor-internal IP, anonymized infrastructure identifiers).
- Full report: we provide access via a secure, watermarked viewer (no download, session timeouts, copy/paste disabled, and per-user watermarking). We typically require an NDA with limited retention plus an agreement not to share screenshots.
- For legal ease, we can propose a narrow NDA addendum that lists specific carve-outs (e.g., redaction responsibility, escrow, and viewing-only rights).

I'll loop in Marissa (security) and Laura (sales/legal interface) to propose wording and a delivery timeline. Can you share the names/emails of the reviewers who need access and the desired window (days)?

Next steps I propose:
1) Draft NDA addendum and redaction matrix (we'll attach a suggested redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx).
2) Provide exec summary PDF for download within 2 business days after NDA acceptance.
3) Open secure viewer sessions for up to 5 named reviewers for a 7-day window (adjustable).

--
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary access for procurement review

On Tue, Nov 24, 2026 at 11:04 AM Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'll loop in Marissa (security) and Laura (sales/legal interface) to propose wording and a delivery timeline.

Thanks Alex. Internal notes and recommended approach:

- Redaction scope: we will remove code snippets that reveal internal model tokenization heuristics, replace raw IP addresses with tags (e.g., [REDACTED-IP-1]) and redact any customer tenant IDs. We will not redact vulnerability descriptions themselves — only details that could enable exploit replication outside the customer's environment.
- Watermarking: per-user email + timestamp rendered on every page and embedded in image layers.
- Viewer controls: browser-based viewer hosted in our secure environment (no right-click, print suppressed, clipboard burn). Session TTL by default 7 days; we can shorten to 72 hours on request.
- Legal carve-outs we typically ask for: allowed retention (view-only), prohibition on screenshots (contractual clause), and an audit log export if FinCo requires evidence of who viewed what.

I'll prepare the redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx and remediation_tracker_v20261207.csv with expected ETA for each fix (we have several low/med findings scheduled for Dec 15 and a couple of medium-high items scheduled for Jan 10).

Marissa
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
From: Harold Bishop <procurement@fincorp.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Maya Lanning <security@fincorp.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary access for procurement review

Alex / Maya — quick clarification from procurement: we can sign a viewing-only NDA but need the following in writing:

- Confirmation that FinCo will NOT be able to download the full report or take copies out of the viewer.
- A statement of the maximum viewing window and the possibility of a one-time extension.
- A list of agreed redaction categories (e.g., infrastructure IPs, internal hostnames, internal API keys).

Also, any remediation evidence (ticket IDs, patch notes) should be provided to procurement as a CSV mapping finding IDs -> closure ETA. If you can produce that CSV, procurement will accept the viewer model rather than a full file transfer.

Regards,
Harold Bishop
Senior Procurement Manager
FinCo Financial
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Lanning <security@fincorp.com>, Harold Bishop <procurement@fincorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pen test report + exec summary access for procurement review

Hi Maya / Harold — thanks for the specifics. Finalizing deliverables below: 

1) NDA addendum sent via DocuSign (envelope ID: 0a9f-DSN-5543) — narrow viewing-only terms, prohibition on screenshots, and a 90-day record retention clause.
2) Exec summary (redaction applied) attached for download once NDA completes (PDF). Attachment: exec_summary_redacted_v1.pdf (stub).
3) Full technical report access via secure viewer: session link (one per reviewer) will be generated after sign-off. Default window: 72 hours; we can extend once on written request. Viewer will watermark email + timestamp and disable printing/download.
4) Remediation tracker attached: remediation_tracker_v20261207.csv (maps finding IDs to tickets and ETA).

Attachments in this thread (for internal tracking): redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx, remediation_tracker_v20261207.csv.

Action items:
- Alex: finalize DocuSign and send to Harold/FinCo procurement (today).
- Marissa/Diego: stand by to provision viewer sessions and adjust TTL to 72 hours.
- Laura: confirm the precise wording for the screenshot prohibition and required audit-log export.

If you confirm the reviewer list (full names and emails), we will issue the viewer links as soon as the envelope is completed.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: exec_summary_redacted_v1.pdf (PDF stub), redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), remediation_tracker_v20261207.csv (spreadsheet stub)
